title: Golden Hour Drive
summary: A breezy, upbeat track capturing the electric energy and carefree joy of a summer road trip with close friends as the sun begins to set.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Windows down, the heat is rising
Laughter echoes through the window
Shadows stretch on asphalt lines
We’re chasing time, we’re crossing miles
The radio plays our favorite song
Right where we belong
[Chorus]
Oh, it’s golden hour drive
Nothing left to hide
Just you and me and the open sky
Let the worry fly
Yeah, it’s golden hour drive
Summers ours to find
In this moment, everything is fine
[Verse]
Maps are lost, we don’t need ‘em
Hearts are full, no need to plead ‘em
Static crackles, voices sing
Making memories that will cling
The air smells like pine and salt
This feeling can’t be faulted
[Chorus]
Oh, it’s golden hour drive
Nothing left to hide
Just you and me and the open sky
Let the worry fly
Yeah, it’s golden hour drive
Summers ours to find
In this moment, everything is fine
